Distinguished delegates, ladies and gentlemen, representatives of non-governmental organizations, as we conclude the 2026 resumed session of the Committee on Non-Governmental Organizations, I wish to express my sincere appreciation to all committee members, representatives of non-governmental organizations, and the Secretariat for their dedication and exemplary work throughout the position. I also wish to underscore the constructive and collegial spirit that characterized our deliberations over the past two weeks, which reaffirmed our shared commitment to strengthening the efficiency and transparency of the Committee's work. This session marked a significant undertaking during which the Committee reviewed 102 new applications for consultative status and 361 applications deferred from previous sessions, bringing the total number of applications considered to 463. In addition, the Committee examined two deferred reclassification requests, one deferred merger, and reviewed and reviewed 547 new quadrennial reports, along with 167 deferred reports from previous sessions. As a result of our deliberations, 340 organizations had their consultative status suspended, 56 organizations had their status reinstated, and the status of 148 organizations was withdrawn. The Committee also took note of 10 requests for a change of name. As of the close of today's meeting, a total of 86 organizations were recommended for consultative status, representing 19% of all applications under review. This includes 70% of new applications and 4% of deferred applications. Dear colleagues, I wish to express my appreciation to the non-governmental organizations that submitted timely written responses to the Committee's questions, as well as to those that participated in person during the interactive question and answer conversations. Their candid and constructive engagement has been essential to the Committee's work. NGOs continue to play a vital role within the United Nations by amplifying the voices of marginalized communities and contributing valuable expertise and perspectives to our deliberations. I also want to commend the NGO branch and the Secretariat for their high-level of professionalism and commitment. Their efforts in managing the large volume of applications and Quadrennial Reports, as well as in supporting Committee members and NGOs, were instrumental to the effective functioning of the Committee. I would like also to thank my fellow Vice Chair for his dedication and all his efforts, and I address my thanks as well to the wonderful work that has been done by the interpreters during this resumed session. Please also be reminded that the Committee will reconvene on Friday, 5th of June to adopt the final report of the session. Once again, I thank you for your strong support, collaboration, commitment. Together, we have brought this session to a successful close. Thank you. The meeting— I declare the 2026 resumed session of the Committee on Non-Governmental Organizations suspended. The meeting is adjourned.
